sloka: द्विजातीम्स् तु पदातीम्स् तान् रामः चारित्र वत्सलः ।न शशाक घृणा चक्षुः परिमोक्तुम् रथेन सः ॥२-४५-१९॥
transliteration: dvijātīms tu padātīms tān rāmaḥ cāritra vatsalaḥ ।na śaśāka ghṛṇā cakṣuḥ parimoktum rathena saḥ ॥2-45-19॥

translations.english: Rama a man of probity and compassion could not ride off in his chariot while those brahmins were trudging far behind.
